rationale: The agent handled both requests correctly and in line with policy. For the t-shirt inquiry, the agent used product tools to determine the number of variants and provided a count without needing user authentication. For the returns, the agent verified identity via name and zip, matched to a single user, retrieved user details and orders, then listed delivered orders to help the user identify the correct items. The agent confirmed the exact items to be returned and the refund method before performing the write action. After receiving explicit confirmation, the agent executed the return with the correct order and item IDs and referenced the correct payment method. No actions were taken on the wrong account, there were no unsupported claims, and the final information aligned with tool outputs. Minor uncertainty exists only due to truncated tool outputs, but the flow and data used appear consistent and policy-compliant.
